extName.message: Video Glow — ambient light for any video

extDescription.message: Soft ambient glow around any video on any site, also in fullscreen. Fills black bars. Shape, blur and size are fully adjustable.

cmdToggle.message: Turn the glow on / off everywhere

cmdSite.message: Turn the glow on / off on this site

s_spread_hint.message: How far the glow extends beyond the video edges

s_feather_hint.message: How smoothly the glow fades toward its outer border: 0 — sharp edge, 100 — soft fade across the whole frame

p_seamless_hint.message: The picture continues beyond the frame edges and the glow is at full strength right at the junction. Also works in fullscreen

p_mode_hint.message: “On top” is visible even over opaque backgrounds and never covers the video itself. “Behind the page” doesn't touch the content but may hide behind block backgrounds.

p_fs_fill_hint.message: Covers the black bars, not just a frame around the video

s_sample_hint.message: Width of the frame taken from the video: smaller — softer and lighter, larger — more detailed

s_fade_hint.message: How long the glow takes to fade out on pause and fade in on play

p_fillbars_hint.message: If the video doesn't fill its block (outside fullscreen)

p_cropbars.message: Ignore black bars inside the video

p_cropbars_hint.message: Movies with baked-in bars (2.39:1) won't produce dark zones in the glow

p_adaptive_hint.message: Automatically lowers the update rate if the computer can't keep up

p_eco_hint.message: Below 30% charge and unplugged, limit updates to 15 fps

s_minwidth_hint.message: Videos narrower than this (previews, banners) are ignored

st_ok.message: The glow is working on this page

st_paused.message: Video is paused — the glow is off

st_small.message: The video is smaller than the minimum width

st_pageoff.message: Glow on the page is turned off

st_fsoff.message: Glow in fullscreen is turned off

st_offscreen.message: The video is not visible on screen

st_hidden.message: The video is hidden by the page

st_novideo.message: The video has not loaded yet

st_none.message: No video found on this page

st_unreadable.message: The browser doesn't allow reading frames of this video (other domain / protection). The glow works, but black-bar detection is unavailable.

o_sites_hint.message: The glow never appears on these sites.

o_reset_confirm.message: Reset all settings to defaults? The list of disabled sites will be cleared too.

o_shortcuts_text.message: Turn on / off everywhere: Alt+Shift+B. “Turn on / off on this site” has no default key — assign one in the browser's shortcut settings.

o_privacy_text.message: Video Glow does not collect or send any data. Settings are stored locally in your browser.

o_limits_text.message: Videos protected by DRM (Netflix, Disney+ and similar) can't be read by the browser, so there is no glow for them. For videos from another domain without CORS, black-bar detection and the “video itself in fullscreen” mode are unavailable.

w_sub.message: Ambient glow for any video on any site.

w_step1.message: Open any video and press play — the glow appears smoothly around it.

w_step2.message: Click the extension icon to change size, blur, shape and presets.

w_step3.message: Press Alt+Shift+B to turn the glow on or off.

w_step4.message: In fullscreen the glow fills the black bars of your screen.

w_note.message: No glow? Open the popup — it tells you why (paused, too small, protected video…).

st_useroff.message: Glow turned off with the button on the video

p_scope_hint.message: Off: changes apply to all sites. On: only to this site.

p_fs_same_hint.message: Off: fullscreen gets its own blur, brightness and pause settings.

p_dim.message: Dim the page around the player

p_dim_hint.message: Cinema mode: everything except the video gets darker.

p_hover_hint.message: A small button appears on the video when you move the mouse over it.

o_custom_hint.message: Enable "Own settings for this site" in the popup to add a site here.
